lines: I'll trick my friend by sending him a Haunter holding an Everstone for his Machoke, this way I'll be the only one with a powerful Stockmonster!

lines: I'm planning to sell some of my farm's Stockmonster as I have too many, but the Tower's Staff has yet to give me the official approval...
Come back again later if you're interested!

name: Berry lady
lines: The Oran Berry plant has grown very fast, it puts a smile on my face!
With that said, there's still some time left until the Sitrus Berries grow into maturity...
Oh sorry, I didn't hear you there, I was too lost in thought about these Berry trees!
You see, StockmonsterSDK is capable of directly managing Berries and their growth.
It's recommended to directly initialize the Berry trees inside your introduction.
As does this demo!

name: $ Limited Items Seller
lines: I have some very rare and useful items to sell, but I was told to wait for the last comer to go to the Tower...

lines: Hello, budding strategist!

.[WAIT 20].[WAIT 20].[WAIT 60]
You do understand what I'm saying, right?
Ah, this puts a smile on my face!
Oh, sorry then, I got all fired up over nothing,

name: The Rumor Guy
lines: There's a rumor going around about the Tower, apparently it took years to build it.
Those rumors also say that in the beginning, it was supposed to be a small region, but their conceptors thought it was too ambitious...
But some other rumors say that apparently, this region project wasn't given up on!
But, well, those are rumors at the end of the day...

name: Timelord
lines: The problem of time isn't one to begin with...
I knew you'd come... You see, I possess powers beyond anything you could ever imagine.
Warping time is child's play for me...
I can share it with you if you want.
For instance, I'm able to change the frame of reference of time in our reality.
I can choose to swap time to a real clock, so your PC's, or a virtual clock.

name: Sailor
lines: You already want to leave ?
I'm not ready at all to weigh anchor!

name: Lass
lines: I was told by a friend that we can't fish on the dock.

lines: Didn't you get to the Tower yet?
Hello young fisherman in the making!
Here's my stock of...
Stop by it and come see me again so I can show my catches!

Stop by it and come see me again so I can show my catches!

name: Kakuna

lines: Do you know how to hide an item and make it searchable using the Dowsing Machine?
To do that, the name of the event needs to start with "invisible_" or be exactly named "OBJ_INVISIBLE".
Hello, young explorer!
Everyone on this Island calls me the "Item Finder," name of which was given to me for the countless hours I spent searching rarities in the wild...
... with the help of my marvelous Dowsing Machine!
... Wait... You have one too?

lines: Did you catch it? Good job! It's really not easy to find an Eon Stockmonster with their abilities.

Well then Maker, seems like we are done!
Oh, well, seems like someone might have been a little too hard on the poor beast, to the point of defeating it...
These things happen, don't worry.
Time for a magic trick!

name: Chansey
lines: Chan-chansey!
Chansey heals your team.[WAIT 90]
Now the only thing left is to bind this to that and...
Are you crazy, scaring people like that without announcing yourself?!
I almost had a heart attack...
Alright, okay, I'm calm now...
? It does ring a bell...
The name's Scorbutics, but you can call me Scor.
The television flickers strangely...
The television flickers strangely...

name: Radio
lines: An old radio. It seems like it doesn't have any charge left.

name: Trash bin
lines: Dumpster diving is such a weird obsession...
Do you believe all dumpsters contain things?
Well, sorry not sorry, this one does not.
It does not contain any interesting item, but it contains words.
A lot of words.
... Oh, wait, there's a CD at the bottom of the dumpster.

name: Laptop
lines: A laptop.

name: Scor
lines: Ah, there you are.
The general lights of this basement and all the devices in here are out of power.
Only the basement's secondary lights are still on, as they're connected to an auxiliary generator...
I'm sure you'll agree with me: it makes no sense to plug a television to an auxiliary generator.
So we can deduce the problem is caused by this television..
I have my own theory, but I prefer to keep it to myself for now.

name: Scor
lines: Oh, well, , thanks for visiting me!
I'm working on a top-secret project, so I can't speak about it here...
Please come back to see me again when you have some time, it's quite lonely here.
